title: Conduit load under railway track (broad gauge)

symbols.definition: Uniformly distributed load in tonnes / m2 from the surface directly over the conduit
Axle load in tonnes (22.5 tonnes for Broad gauge)
Length of the sleeper in m (2.7 m for Broad gauge)
Distance between the two axles (1.84 m for broad gauge)
Weight of the track structure in tones/m (0.3 tonnes/m for broad gauge)
Load coefficient which depends on the height of the top of sleeper from the top of the conduit
Width of the conduit in m

applicability: Load on conduits under railway track. For broad gauge track, the formula reduces to the printed 32.14 expression.
